director-status-line: Director: {0}; haunting {1} of {2}; ledger entries: {3}; blocks to restore: {4}. More: /walkers director status
director-cmd-desc: The director: who is haunted, the ledger of deaths and returns, debug stand-ins. Without a subcommand it shows the status
director-cmd-status-desc: Shows every walker and player as the director sees them, or one walker (by id) or one player in detail
director-cmd-haunt-desc: Starts a haunt on an online player or stand-in now, skipping the rolls, rests and caps, or moves their haunt to a stage (1 to 5)
director-cmd-end-desc: Ends a walker (by id, or the one haunting a player): rest (default) ends its haunt, ledger puts it in the ledger as if it died, banish banishes it for good
director-cmd-return-desc: Shows when a walker in the ledger returns; with now, it returns at once to its last victim
director-cmd-ledger-desc: Lists the ledger: every walker death, how it died and what came of it
director-cmd-tick-desc: Runs one director update now instead of waiting for the next one
director-cmd-standin-desc: Debug stand-in victims (needs debug.standInVictims): a vanilla player bot the director treats as a lone player
director-cmd-standin-add-desc: Places a stand-in where you stand, at a given position, or from the console at the world spawn
director-cmd-standin-remove-desc: Removes a stand-in by its name, such as standin-1
director-status-header: Director: {0}; haunting {1} of {2}; ledger entries: {3}; blocks to restore: {4}; ladder: {5}
director-status-memory: Memory: pace {0:0.##}, returns {1}, escalation {3}, feature data: {2}
director-status-record: {0}: first seen day {1}, rests until day {2} ({3:0.#} days left), marked by walker {4}
director-status-unknown-player: The director knows nothing about {0} yet
director-walker-haunting: Walker {0}: haunting {1} at stage {2}, clock {3:0.#} of {4} days, wearing a {5} deer, returns {6}
director-walker-paused: Walker {0}: haunt on {1} paused at stage {2} ({3}), paused {4:0.#} of {5} days
director-walker-down: Walker {0}: dead, waiting for its body's outcome
director-walker-waiting: Walker {0}: in the ledger, returns on day {1} (in {2:0.#} days)
director-walker-resting-return: Walker {0}: resting after a return whose victim stayed away; its next haunt is return {1} plus one
director-no-walker-for: No walker is {0}, or haunts them
director-not-online: {0} is not an online player or a loaded stand-in
director-standins-off: Stand-ins are off. Turn them on with /walkers config debug.standInVictims true
director-haunt-already: Walker {0} already haunts {1}, at stage {2}. Name a stage to move it
director-haunt-started: Walker {0} now haunts {1}, at stage {2}, wearing a {3} deer
director-already-ledger: Walker {0} is already in the ledger or banished
director-ended-rest: Walker {0}'s haunt has ended; it rests
director-ended-ledger: Walker {0} is in the ledger and will return
director-not-waiting: Walker {0} is not in the ledger
director-return-when: Walker {0} returns on day {1} (in {2:0.#} days), to {3}
director-returned: Walker {0} has returned and haunts {1} at stage {2}
director-return-waits: Walker {0} is due back, but waits for {1} to be online, eligible and near forest
director-ledger-header: Ledger, oldest first ({0} in all; the last 20 are shown):
director-ledger-entry: Walker {0} died on day {1} at {2}, {3}, {4}: {5}{6}; victim {7}; {8}
director-outcome-pending: the body lies; returns on day {0} unless banished
director-standin-no-spot: Found no free ground to stand on there
director-standin-none: No stand-ins. Add one with /walkers director standin add
director-cmd-furs-desc: Marks from unnatural furs: who carries walker furs and how strongly they are marked. Without a subcommand it shows them all
director-cmd-furs-status-desc: Shows every fur mark, or one player's
director-cmd-furs-clear-desc: Clears every fur mark, or one player's
director-furs-header: Fur marks (a mark takes after {0:0.#} hours of carrying):
director-furs-header-off: Fur marks are off (furs.markTarget); furs are trophies only. Kept marks:
